3.50 Compositionality
Definition
Compositionality is given when the behavior of a software component or
subsystem of a system is independent of the overall system load and
configuration.
BMW
Initiator
Further
Explanations
Compositionality is an important property of deterministic systems. This property
leads to a complete decoupling of systems. Smooth subsystem integration without
backlashes is then easily achievable.
Comment
--
Example
A new component or a subsystem can be added to a system without changing the
behavior of the original components.
